I tried to explain the problems of that concept and term, the term used. An ordinary police can be considered paramilitary. So if you understand the concept in that way, then I'm not able to answer you. But since we're talking about police units here, we cannot say that that was a paramilitary unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: Why was it necessary to have a militarised unit operating on your territory, if your answer is correct and honest, unknown to a senior policeman like you?

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: What unit are you referring to? I apologise.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic said, and you accept, was formed in 1991. Why was it necessary to have such a unit answerable to the MUP from 1991?

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Let me repeat: It was not a paramilitary unit. It was a regular unit, a regular unit with the frameworks of the state security department.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... how come --

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Now, I don't know how many times you want me to repeat this, but --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: You tell us: If it was a regular unit -- if it was a regular unit, how come you knew nothing about it, so you tell us?

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Prosecutor, I said quite clearly several times that I do know that it existed within the state security department, and I told you what I knew about when it was formed, and I said that I had heard that Franko Simatovic said that it had been formed in 1991. But I attended the ceremony at the end of the winter, beginning of spring, I believe it was, 1996, and that ceremony was organised --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: I'm going to cut you short --

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- with regard to the establishment of the unit for special operations.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: Let me remind you of two things: It was you who used the word "paramilitary" about it. That's the first thing. And the second thing, in answers just a few minutes ago, you said, "I just heard --"

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's not true.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: I'll check the LiveNote. You said a few minutes ago, "I just heard at an interview I had in Belgrade two or three months ago that Mr. Franko mentioned the formation of that unit in 1991." Two or three months ago is, what, four years after you gave up being an active policeman? Now, will you tell us, please, why this accused had, from 1991, a unit you described yesterday as paramilitary in nature operating apparently unknown to a regular and senior policeman? Why?

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Prosecutor, I really am not able to follow you. I do apologise. Perhaps I don't have the possibility of memorising all this, but you are stringing a series of questions, five of them, very different ones. I never said that the JSO was a paramilitary group. I don't remember having said that. Possibly, but then it was a slip of the tongue certainly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: That's true, as far as I can remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: He used the term yesterday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: In relation to 1991, to 1996?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: Yes, the Red Berets.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: May I just conclude with this --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: But 1991 to 1996 there was a different name.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Robinson. The transcript is going to slip away. He said was organised, and then he said 1996. He said that ceremony was organised in 1996, but it -- what didn't come up in the transcript. That's what he's talking about.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: May I ask one more question? I see the time. I'm happy to go on, but I expect you want to rise.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: One more question and I'll make it simple so that you can follow it. One way or another, Mr. Stevanovic, you've told us that you first learnt three months ago of a unit that Mr. Simatovic ran from 1991 on the territory of the former Yugoslavia. Do you follow me? That's the position. You have --

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Robinson, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Milosevic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The witness said that three months ago he heard that Simatovic had said that a unit existed, not that he heard about the unit three months ago. He said that three months ago he heard that Simatovic had said that.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's precisely how it was. Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's a big difference.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: That's my understanding.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: When did you first learn about this unit. And tell us what it did. We're going to find out what it did, but you tell us what it did.

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I have to repeat: Again, I attended the ceremony held with respect to the organisation of this unit in the spring of 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: And what did the unit do between 1991 and 1996?

utterances.speaker: OBRAD STEVANOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, of course it didn't exist during that period. It was formed in 1996.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: We have to adjourn. We're past the time for adjournment. We will adjourn until Tuesday, 9.00 a.m., next week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
